value.rationale: Reidemeister spectra form an active published classification problem. This establishes a new natural infinite family with noncyclic Sylow p-subgroup, a full orbit-size profile for each automorphism, complete attainable pair geometry including the characteristic-three Jordan-block realization, and a prime-independent exact count of distinct spectrum values. The paired-eigenspace feasibility is substantive beyond a textbook Reidemeister count.
